messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback initiated for service=runtime-api env=prod-eu1. reverting tag v2.8.1 -> v2.7.4. Trigger: canary error-rate spike + latency regressions. Roll ID=rbk-2268888888. started by @sanjay. ETA ~3m. Action plan: unroute affected canary, deploy v2.7.4, pin previous tag, monitor metrics.

sanjay: Kicked it. I'm on logs and routing changes. Please don't merge any release branches into prod until we finish.

maria_eng: Copy. Any DB migrations or long-running jobs in this release?

sanjay: No migrations. Pure runtime/kernel change in the serving binary. Should be a straight revert.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Removing canary traffic from eu1 pool now. :white_check_mark:

leo: Heads-up — KV cache warmup might cause a burst of 502s for a few minutes after traffic shift. Watch error distribution, not just averages.

emily_pm: Notifying CS about a short impact window and that we're reverting.

deploy-bot: [deploy] revert deploy in progress. Roll ID=rbk-2268888888. Step 1/4: pulling image registry.redwood/runtime-api:v2.7.4 (sha:abcd1234). Step 2/4: scheduling pods on eu1-gpu-pool. Step 3/4: draining v2.8.1 pods. Step 4/4: healthchecks + route swap.

maria_eng: tailing pod logs: `kubectl -n runtime-api logs -f runtime-api-v2-7-4-abcde` — startup looks green, readiness probes passing.

sanjay: traffic shifted: v2.8.1 100% -> 0% (graceful drain). routing confirmed by envoy metrics.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback halfway: healthchecks passing on 80% of pods, KV warmup in progress, expect transient 502s for ~90s.

leo: seeing a small 2m spike in 502s and CPU on new pods, but latency back to baseline for completed requests.

ops-oncall: keeping an eye, will escalate if >5% errors persist for 5m.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback completed. Roll ID=rbk-2268888888. Revert to v2.7.4 successful in prod-eu1. All pods Ready=100%. Pin set: runtime-api -> v2.7.4. Metrics snapshot: error-rate within baseline, p95 latency restored. Notified: @eng-oncall @customer-success. :tada:

emily_pm: Great, thanks. Can someone add rollout diff and the script output to the ticket?

sanjay: Will open a follow-up bug with perf regression details, diff, and full deploy logs. Assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime for root-cause.

maria_eng: Added the `kubectl` output and the deploy logs to the rollback ticket: RBK-2268888888.

ops-oncall: Confirming post-mortem watch window: 30m. Will escalate to SRE if any regressions reappear.

emily_pm: I'll schedule a change-window to attempt a fixed rollout next week after mitigations.

sanjay: ack. No further prod merges until we have a plan.

deploy-bot: [audit] release-note: reverted v2.8.1 due to latency/error regression introduced by kernel optimization. Revert tag: v2.7.4 pinned. Full logs: https://internal/release/logs/rbk-2268888888.

leo: thx all.

maria_eng: thanks.

sanjay: closing thread, will link the postmortem when ready.
